newsitem.title: USA: Anchor Glass to object to plans for its pensions.
newsitem.headline: Anchor Glass to object to plans for its pensions.

text.p: Anchor Glass Container Corp said on Friday it would object to a plan by the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp to terminate the company's defined benefit pension plans in a federal court.
Pension Benefit said earlier it would protect the underfunded pensions of 15,600 workers and retirees Anchor Glass, which filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September.
Pension Benefit said it would ask a U.S. District Court to terminate three of the Anchor's pension plans effective January 9 and to have Pension Benefit named trustee.
The company said it was holding negotiations with Pension Benefit to avoid termination of the plans.
But Anchor said if the plans went ahead, it would strongly object in court to any application to have the plans terminated.
